speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
text: asked the Minister for Manpower how many couples aged 65 years and above are currently supported by only one CPF LIFE payout and how many of the spouses not receiving such payouts are women.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This could reflect social norms in the past where many women were full-time caregivers and either did not work or worked irregularly and hence, would have less CPF.

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I should have written the question as a projection.

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Will the Ministry consider as a kind of scheme for the future that will allow the transfer of ownership of CPF LIFE from the owner to the spouse, just in case the owner passes on, considering that a lot of spouses, which could be mostly women, would be left without income if the spouse were to pass on early?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: To some extent, members can already exercise an option to do so, so that their spouses who they expect to outlive them can have better income streams after they pass on.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: What we have done is to make it easier for members to transfer their CPF savings and to make cash top-ups to their spouses' accounts, so that the spouses too can get their own stream of income or larger stream of income payouts in retirement.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: What I can share with you is that the various enhancements that have been made to the rules surrounding transfers and cash top-ups have had an effect.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: A good number of them, as a result of these transfers and top-ups, were able to achieve better retirement adequacy.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Because then in that sense, what the actuaries will have to take into account is not one person's expected lifespan but two persons' expected lifespans.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: And that would differ from couple to couple.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: It is already challenging enough to try and estimate for each person.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I should also add that it is not just spouses who can make transfers and cash top-ups.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: We made it easier for children to do so.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: This is all part of enhancing the family support for retirement adequacy.
